subject: Auth controls & SOC2 evidence — requested clarifications
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medalign.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: security@medalign.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts

Hi Ben,

We're starting our formal vendor security assessment for Redwood. Can you please provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the coverage period doesn't include Q1 2027? In addition to the report, our security team has asked for a few discrete artifacts to validate controls referenced in your report:

- Evidence of MFA enforcement for all production accounts (timestamped proof or rollout plan + enforcement date)
- A time-limited auth-log slice (user auths + successful/failed outcomes) covering a two-week window we can agree on
- Recent access review summary (who performed reviews and any critical remediation)

We may follow up with an encrypted upload link. Timeline: we'd like these by EOD Wednesday (May 12) to keep our procurement timeline on track.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Director, InfoSec — MedAlign Health
Tom.Reynolds@medalign.com

---
Attachment: requested_controls_checklist.xlsx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medalign.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + control artifacts

Tom — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to support; tagging Neha (compliance lead) and Vivek (security ops) to coordinate artifacts and the log slice. A few quick clarifying questions so we provide exactly what you need:

1) For MFA enforcement, do you need a single point-in-time screenshot + enforcement policy, or an enforcement timeline showing rollout progress and enforcement date for all prod orgs?
2) For the auth-log slice, please confirm the preferred two-week window and whether you need IP addresses and device/user-agent fields redacted.
3) For access reviews, do you want the raw reviewer spreadsheets, or a summary PDF with reviewers, dates, and remediation notes (we typically provide the summary + supporting spreadsheets on request).

We'll prepare the SOC 2 report and a bridge letter if the audit coverage ends before May 2027. Neha — can you assemble the evidence artifacts and a proposed log window? Vivek — can you confirm whether we can generate a two-week auth log extract with the requested columns and safe redaction?

I'll share an encrypted upload link once we have the artifacts packaged. Thanks — aiming to get this to you by EOD May 11.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Ben / Vivek — plan below for MedAlign request:

- SOC 2 artifact: provide Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (attestation report) + bridge letter draft if they need coverage through 05/2027.
- MFA evidence: produce mfa-rollout-summary.pdf that includes enforcement date (2026-11-17), policy link, and a redacted screenshot of admin console showing 'MFA required for all users' flag. Also include the rollout change log (who/when).
- Auth logs: Vivek to export a two-week slice; propose window May 1–14, 2027. We'll include columns: timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type (auth_success/auth_fail), src_ip (CIDR / redacted to /24 if requested), device (UA string truncated). We'll provide a CSV stub named auth-log-slice-may2027.csv.
- Access review: summary PDF with reviewer names (internal), dates (Q1 2027), and remediation actions; supporting spreadsheet available on request (sensitive emails redacted).

Vivek — can you confirm the export is possible without including plaintext PII? We will deliver the artifacts via encrypted S3 link and include checksums. Timeline: package by EOD May 10, upload and notify Ben.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Tom — attaching the artifacts we discussed. See notes below and let me know if you want any additional redaction or a narrower log window.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report — control testing period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31)
- mfa-rollout-summary.pdf (policy + enforcement date + screenshot (redacted))
- auth-log-slice-may2027.csv (two-week slice, timestamps in UTC, user_ids hashed)

Notes:
- Enforcement date for MFA: 2026-11-17 (full org). The rollout summary includes the approval ticket and migration cutover details.
- The auth-log CSV has src_ip redacted to /24 and user_id hashed; we can provide a version with full /32 IPs under an NDA if MedAlign requires it.
- Access review summary is included in the SOC2 supplement section; if you need raw spreadsheets with reviewer comments, we'll share via secure upload after a quick redaction pass.

If the auth-log window needs to change, propose May 3–16 and we'll regenerate.

Best,
Ben

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- Confirmed we received Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf and the mfa-rollout-summary.pdf. The enforcement date confirmation is helpful.
- For the auth-log slice: can you narrow to May 5–18, 2027 (two-week window) and include full src_ip (no CIDR) for forensic correlation? If there are concerns about PII, MedAlign is happy to execute an Addendum/NDA to accept full IPs.
- For access review evidence: please provide the summary PDF now and the supporting spreadsheet (redacted as needed) after you confirm what fields will be redacted. Our procurement team will also need a bridge letter if the SOC report period ends 2026-12-31 and we expect coverage into mid-2027.

If you can send an updated log slice and the bridge letter by EOD Wednesday (May 12), procurement will proceed. Appreciate the responsiveness.

Regards,
Tom Reynolds
